hero.title: Your menu in, an allergen menu out
hero.lead: Upload a photo or PDF of your menu. PlateGuard reads the dishes and ingredients, you check them, and you have a guest menu where guests tick their allergies plus an allergen card as a PDF. Free to start.
hero.note: No POS link needed. No credit card.
hero.dish2Why: Without the jus: the waiter knows what to change

how.title: Start with what you already have
how.lead: No retyping recipes. Your menu is the start.
how.step1Text: A photo or PDF of your menu. PlateGuard picks out the dishes, parts and ingredients, with the allergens in them.
how.step2Text: You or your chef confirm the allergens per ingredient. Until then the guest sees 'unknown', never 'safe'.
how.step3Text: A QR code on the table to your guest menu, and the allergen card as a PDF at the till. Every version dated.

why.title: Protection, without extra work for the floor
why.nvwaText: You must be able to show which allergens are in your dishes. The allergen card is that overview, per published version, ready to print.
why.costText: An allergic reaction costs a guest their evening and you your name, a claim or a fine. One incident costs more than a year of PlateGuard.
why.calmText: For guests without an allergy nothing changes. Only at an allergy table does PlateGuard ask the waiter for anything, and it says per dish what to do.

plans.title: Start free, grow when you want
plans.freeText: Guest menu with an allergen filter, the allergen card as a PDF, and reading your menu from a photo or PDF. No POS link.
plans.kitchenText: Free plus allergies per seat, an allergy ticket in the kitchen, the cook scans the plate and everything is logged.
plans.fullText: Kitchen plus a link with your POS, a kitchen display, incidents and a dashboard per location.

footer.disclaimer: PlateGuard supports your allergen process. It does not take over the venue's responsibility.

signup.title: Start free
signup.lead: Create your restaurant. Then read in your menu.
signup.name: Your first name
signup.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. You sign in with your first name and this PIN, like your staff will.
signup.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email address. Sign in with your first name and PIN.
signup.error: That did not work. Please try again.
signup.terms: Free for as long as you like: guest menu and allergen card. Add the kitchen and POS link later.
